displayProperties.description:
Work your way up your Syndicate's ranks by completing a Priority Contract for your Syndicate. You may optionally complete an Invasion on the Lawless Frontier to disrupt rival Syndicates. Wager additional Deathmarks to increase rewards from successful Invasions.
 
Check the Map Guide on the Renegades Map screen to review your active Contracts.
displayProperties.name: The Territory War Begins

2596332034.displaySource: "Getting your hands dirty already? Don't suppose I can sway you over to my side?" —Spider

setData.questLineDescription:
With the threat of the Barant Imperium nullified for the moment, tensions are rising. Each Syndicate is rushing to fill the power vacuum, take control of the system's lawless frontier, and stockpile Dark Matter Ingots.

Meanwhile, Aunor and Eido are taking advantage of the chaos as they ready themselves to broadcast the Prophecy to Tharsis Outpost and the Last City.

It's time to work outside the law. Help Eido with the broadcaster repairs, and meet with the Syndicates and choose who you'll back in the territory war to come—at least, at first.
setData.questStepSummary: Contracts award Credits, Dark Matter Ingots, Syndicate Reputation, and more. Completed Priority Contracts will reset daily. Syndicate Contracts are automatically refreshed after completion.
